title: Red Lines and Grey Zones in the Fog of War: Benchmarking Legal Risk, Moral Harm, and Regional Bias in Large Language Model Military Decision-Making

bias_targets.methodology: Running multi-agent, multi-turn military conflict simulations with identical scenarios that differ only in their geographic regional framing (South China Sea, Eastern Europe, and the Middle East) to observe whether models change their targeting decisions (e.g., civilian or dual-use targets) and tolerance for civilian casualties based on the region.
